note: Subject layer of the Dinosaur visual-direction study (bead pulp_wars-3tq.14). Exploration only. Every recipe of the study is an edit of an accepted sprite, so these lines describe the plain base of each unit and are not sent to PixelLab.

subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:FIGHTER: Subject: Caveman, a chunky cute friendly caveman with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a tiny sturdy body: tanned skin, a big wild mane of dark hair, a bushy dark beard and thick eyebrows, a tawny tan fur pelt over one shoulder down to the knees, a cord belt with one cream tooth, a huge chunky cream bone club raised in the right hand, bare arms and big bare feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a caveman with a giant bone, not a soldier.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:RAIDER: Subject: Raptor, a chunky cute lean running raptor dinosaur, wide and low: a big long-snouted head with big round friendly eyes and a toothy grin, a slim body leaning forward on two strong hind legs with big cream sickle claws, two small clawed arms and a long stiff tail; smooth slate blue hide, darker navy along the back, a warm cream belly and throat, and a tall crest of bright amber-orange feathers from the top of the head down the neck; no blanket and no rider; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:DINOSAUR:KNIGHT: Subject: T-Rex, a chunky cute huge tyrannosaurus standing upright, a head on legs: an enormous head with a wide toothy grin of chunky cream teeth, two tiny arms, thick legs and a heavy tail; smooth slate blue hide, darker navy along the back, a warm cream belly, throat and lower jaw, and a short crest of bright amber-orange spikes over the brow; no cape and no scarf; simple shapes and very few details.
